azhdarchid_large_corrected.action: Initial field identification and site documentation
azhdarchid_large_corrected.morphology: Massive, elongate manus print with strong digit III focus. Pes is robust and plantigrade with wide digit spread; indicates heavy weight-bearing on soft, damp silt.

technical_specs.scale_directive: Force large-scale footprint dominance in frame; trackway must occupy 60% of the vertical and horizontal space to accurately reflect adult azhdarchid dimensions
